name: myself
description: MySelf — research platform for self-report surveys and LLM-supported micro-narrative research

scripts.test:e2e:sync: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-myself --config infra/firebase/firebase.test.json "playwright test --config playwright.sync.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:studio: pnpm --filter @myself/functions package && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-myself --config infra/firebase/firebase.studio-e2e.json "playwright test --config playwright.studio.config.ts"
scripts.test:studio:shots: pnpm --filter @myself/functions package && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-myself --config infra/firebase/firebase.studio-e2e.json "playwright test --config playwright.studio-shots.config.ts"
